description: The chart represents the distribution of task types, showing the proportion of different tasks. The chart is divided into four slices, although one slice is not labeled or colored distinctly. The largest slice, colored red, represents "Article generation" and accounts for approximately 82.9%. The second-largest slice, colored blue, represents "Article editing" and makes up around 14.6%. The remaining two slices are much smaller, with one colored yellow and the other gray, but their exact proportions and labels are not clearly visible, except that the gray slice appears to be the smallest. The chart includes percentage labels outside the chart for the two larger slices, and the slices are arranged in descending order of size.
